name: devil-lawyer
description: Review proposals through guided questions, five perspectives and an evidence-based judgment.

interface.shortDescription: Review proposals from five practical perspectives.
interface.longDescription: Clarify a proposal one question at a time, review its value, objections, assumptions, feasibility and recipient experience, then receive a clear recommendation and the visible debate record.
defaultPrompt: Use $devil-lawyer to critically review my proposal and clarify any necessary missing context one question at a time.
